title: Benzothia(di)azepine compounds and their use as bile acid regulators
abstract: The present invention relates to 1,5-benzothiazepine and 1,2,5-benzothiadiazepine derivatives of formula (I). These compounds are bile acid regulators with apical sodium-dependent bile acid transporter (ASBT) and/or liver bile acid transporter (LBAT) inhibitory activity. The present invention also relates to pharmaceutical compositions comprising these compounds, and uses of these compounds in the treatment of cardiovascular diseases, fatty acid metabolism and glucose utilization disorders, gastrointestinal diseases and liver diseases.
